gap: No result ChatGPT got (of the four I could open) states that the DDPAI N2 at $49 is the front-only 'N2 Front' variant, that the rear camera comes only in the $89 'N2 Dual', and that DDPAI's hardwire-kit bundle is $49 for the MINIPRO 2K but $59 for the N2 Front.
standout_why: Compared against Auto Roamer (cited), Guidespot (cited) and the DashCamTalk price tracker (cited), all opened 2026-11-21. Auto Roamer already says the 70mai M310 needs a separately bought hardwire kit for parking surveillance, takes 16-256 GB cards and has a 300 mAh lithium battery, so the 70mai half of this angle scores 1 on its own. None of the three mentions any DDPAI model, variant or kit bundle. Guidespot only says the M310 has 'no rear camera option'; DashCamTalk only warns that listings 'may be sold as different kits'. ChatGPT's first answer called the $49 N2 'best front + rear' and its second said 'confirm whether the rear camera is included at this price'; the variant table settles that. Limits: Dash & Drive (cited) failed on a certificate error on every attempt and is unread, and store.ddpai.com returned HTTP 429 on every attempt (including a final retry after waiting out the limit), so the DDPAI figures are the brief's 2026-11-21 store read, not my own.
decides: It removes the DDPAI N2 as a front-and-rear pick under $50: at $49 it is one channel (front only), and the two-channel N2 Dual is $89. It also splits the parking-mode buyer from the plain buyer. The only in-budget package in the brief's tables that includes a hardwire kit is the DDPAI MINIPRO 2K + Hardwire Kit at $49; the N2 Front with the kit is $59, and the 70mai M310 needs 70mai's kit bought separately. The M310 stays the front-only pick on price, but 70mai's own US store showed it sold out at $31.99 on 2026-11-21, so its live price is whatever Amazon shows (DashCamTalk tracked $39.99).

Whether a rear camera can be added later to the single-channel N2 Front: a search summary of a manuals.plus copy of the N2 manual said the rear camera port is 'not available on single-channel models', but manuals.plus returned HTTP 403 and DDPAI's own manual page did not load its text, so I never opened a page stating it.

70mai Hardwire Kit UP03 price, stock and compatible-model list from 70mai's US store: https://70mai.store/products/up03-hardwire-kit returned HTTP 429 on every attempt. A search snippet showed $19.99 and 'ONLY compatible with M310/ A510/ A810/ M500/ Omni', which is not usable without opening the page; without it the M310-plus-kit total against $50 cannot be stated.

Whether DDPAI code SAVEBIGBF (12%) applies to the MINIPRO 2K, N2 Front, MINI2X or MINI PRO 3K variants: the brief's cart tests were on the N5 Pro and Z90 Pro, and I could not reach the store to test these.
A live amazon.com price for the 70mai M310 and for the UP03 kit: the Amazon checker's search returned no output.

What Dash & Drive's 'Best Dash Cams Under $50' (cited in the second chat) says about variants, kits or cards: every fetch failed with a self-signed certificate error and the direct download was not permitted.
Compatibility facts for ChatGPT's other cards (Rexing V1 at Walmart, onn Full HD 1080p front-and-rear set at $49.98, onn 1080p at $24.97): not researched within the call budget.
